description: One-into-five signal switcher: the input reaches one selected output, and the change crossfades over about 40ms

params.text: Selects that output as the one the input reaches, silencing the other four

inputs.text: The signal routed to whichever output is selected

outputs.text: Carries the input while its channel is selected, and silence otherwise

menu: Top label — a box in the menu where the name printed at the top of the panel is typed
Label colour — picks the colour of that top label
Get channel names from mappings — names each channel after the parameter that the matching PatchMaster radio button controls
